source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: This model's demolisher cannon can shoot at enemy units that are in Engagement Range of this model, as long as no other friendly unit is in Engagement Range of the targeted unit. Also, this model's ranged attacks never take the Hit roll penalty for being in Engagement Range of enemy units.

ability.proviso: no other friendly unit is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit
